title: Nonnegativity of assignment weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of the states “free,” “fixed to $1$,” or “fixed to $-1$.” The product of the coordinate weights, which are $ rac12$ for a free state and $ rac14$ for either fixed state, is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state is assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
